'''Version 0.9.0.1''' is the patch released on 15 October 2026, the day after [[Version 0.9.0.0]]. This page lists every documented change from 0.9.0.0, including a few the patch notes do not mention. The wiki now shows values from [[Version 0.9.0.2]], which followed a day later.

'''Spoilers:''' this page names late-story content.

== New content ==
=== Music ===
* The new song announced with 0.9.0.0 now plays. It joins the in-game playlist, which now has 9 tracks, and can also play in the main menu. [[Version 0.9.0.2]] makes the main menu keep playing tracks.

== Changes ==
=== Magic weapons ===
Orbs now wear out. Each cast uses 1 durability, so a new orb lasts 30 casts and then breaks. Orbs cannot be repaired, and being hit does not wear them. See [[Magic weapons]].

Not in the patch notes:
* Like other gear, orbs left in ordinary stashes now lose durability over time.
* Orbs found in [[Random treasure|treasure chests]] are already partly used, with 18 to 29 durability left.
* An orb's resale value falls with its durability.
* When you load an older save, orbs you have equipped, including orbs in an equipped bag, are set to 30 durability. Orbs stored anywhere else keep the 1 durability they had in 0.9.0.0, out of 30, so they break after one cast.

=== Poison and bleeding ===
* A [[Poison|poisoned]] creature now keeps taking its turns while it is out of sight or idle, so poison keeps working until it runs out.
* Not in the patch notes: the same fix applies to bleeding from [[Sharp]] attacks.

[[Wilda]] sells Poison Arrow II at the new price. The higher value also makes it a possible [[Survivor loot|Survivor corpse]] find.

Butchery no longer gives an extra [[Serpent Fang]], [[Small Venom Gland]], [[Small Fire Gland]], [[Troll Fat]], [[Rift Weave]], [[Glow Goo]], [[Scaalmyr Husk]], [[Large Scaalmyr Husk]], [[Glowing Rune]], [[Head of The Terror]], [[Gold Coin]], [[Clay's Magus Hood]] or [[Magi's Ropebelt]]. Its AP reduction is unchanged.

=== Fixes ===
* Clicking in a menu no longer reopens the menu of the last object you used.
* [[Survivor]] guards greet you with "Grand Mother's blessing to you!", and [[Grand Mother]]'s description calls her "Wilda's grandmother". Both were missing their apostrophes.
* Not in the patch notes: the [[Wood Buckler]] inventory icon was retouched. Its stats are unchanged.
